FISHING LICENCE · GREECE

Greece fishing licence

The Coast Guard does not require an ordinary personal or boat licence for recreational sea fishing. Gear, species and area limits still apply, and the boat's flag can affect whether you may fish.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who doesn’t

  • Ordinary recreational marine fishing does not require the former personal or boat fishing licence.

Saltwater

The Coast Guard confirms no ordinary recreational sea licence. This exemption does not remove protected-species or vessel-nationality restrictions.

Rules visitors should know

  • Do not assume a foreign-flag boat can fish; check the Coast Guard's nationality restrictions.
  • Release an accidentally caught live bluefin tuna immediately.
  • The ordinary sea catch limit is 5 kg per angler per 24 hours, with stated gear and single-fish exceptions.

How to buy

No ordinary sea licence purchase is required. Ask the local Port Authority about the planned method and boat.
